profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software developer with an interest in leveraging data to make informed decisions.  A believer in test-driven development for writing software and excelling at debugging.  Follows an analytical approach to problem solving with a desire to providing elegant solutions.  Also comfortable with project management, software system integration and network security.

Current areas of interests include big data and parallel computing on Spark and Hadoop.

Other interests include designing and prototyping hobbyist electronics and learning more about 3D graphics and engines.
